objective: Allow Kabihasnang Ligaw chapters to prepare private manuscript previews with zero uploaded scene photos; keep all scenes optional with their existing save, placement, review, approval, and publication gates.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main 7a3c706d44ab05389a4aa9c4a1bba82ad22f6395 source; read-only live Supabase yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu inspected 2026-11-19: kl_admin_prepare_preview_v1 enforces 2+ illustrations, but kl_admin_action_v1 only requires a prepared preview and all existing media approved (none is allowed). Exact installed production OTA/runtime not inspected; no production mutation authorized by this DEV work.
chosenApproach: Add a later guarded CREATE OR REPLACE migration that accepts 0-12 uploaded illustrations but validates every supplied one; preserve the currently deployed editorial unlock and admin role check. Update the Studio copy and focused Node/SQL regressions without changing release, reward, or media RPCs.
selectionRationale: The 2-photo minimum exists in the backend private-preview function. A client-only change leaves the failure in place; changing release permissions is unnecessary. The additive function fix is isolated and keeps all uploaded art placement and approval enforcement.
alternativeApproaches: Make the button ignore the failed RPC (rejected: would falsely report success).
Allow all unanchored uploaded photos through preview (rejected: approval or placement could be bypassed).
Modify old deployed migration history (rejected: nonadditive and unsafe).
preserveBehaviors: Manuscripts remain independently saved, with minimum title and manuscript length, and unpublished until separately approved
Admin-only preview RPC uses protected SECURITY DEFINER explicit search_path and preserves live editorial unlock for released chapters
Uploaded photos remain optional and retain 1-12 placement, unique exact manuscript anchors, effects, file review and server approval
No auto-release or changes to rewards, chapter statuses, Wall, Connect, AdMob, or Season 2 logic
No production schema modification, CI shortcut, RC or OTA publish from this branch
acceptanceChecks: Zero-scene saved manuscripts can prepare a server-confirmed private preview
One valid photo and up to twelve valid distinct anchored photos remain supported
Uploaded unanchored, invalid or duplicate scenes block the media-inclusive preview until repaired
Every uploaded media item still requires server approval before chapter approval/release
Readonly SQL permissions regression, focused Node tests and existing dynamic scene tests pass in isolated QA
Merge/consolidate only after CI and database staging verification; physical-device and live production verification not claimed
